# Specific leaf area

SLA is projected leaf area per unit dry mass; it anchors the leaf economics
spectrum [@wright_leaf_2004, p. 822]. #anchor evidence-1

Across biomes, SLA correlates positively with mass-based photosynthetic
capacity [@reich_global_1997]. #anchor evidence-2

I suspect SLA responds faster to shade than the spectrum papers assume. #mine
